mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to raise rates, which in turn depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and personal consumption expenditures signals strong underlying demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals deteriorating corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 217.5 in the past 3 months signals accelerating inflation, which increases the likelihood of Fed rate hikes and raises real interest rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 217.5, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k in a single month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in real personal consumption expenditures and residential construction starts indicates robust aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to generate positive 20d returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 followed by a drop in GDP growth below 2.0% annualized signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 102.0 and GDPC1 < 2.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
